QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_25

question.text: When a Cat III AIF undergoes a change of Sponsor/Investment Manager, the mandatory exit provision for dissenting close-ended investors can be WAIVED if:

answer.text: The IM promises to refund management fees
75% of unit holders by value of their investment approve the change
The incoming IM provides a one-year performance guarantee

explanation.text: The Logic: The mandatory exit process for dissenting close-ended investors upon change of Sponsor/IM or control does NOT apply if the AIF has obtained approval of NOT LESS THAN 75% of unit holders by value of their investment. The Trap: SEBI dispensation (A) is not a waiver mechanism. Fee refunds (B) and performance guarantees (D) are commercial sweeteners, not regulatory waivers. Note: The workbook fixes the 75% waiver rule and the mandatory-exit two-valuer/average mechanics; pre-vote whip and process-management advice is not part of the syllabus.
